To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) party discipline is high in the Italian Chamber of Deputies; (2) party discipline is higher for legislators with a safer seat; (3) party discipline is lower for legislators with a dual candidacy; (4) the electoral system is a key determinant of party discipline; and (5) the electoral system has a stronger effect than the electoral path.
